header.description: EQ tab Find Best and Next Best (frmMain InvenFindBest and helpers, through the menu handlers and cmdEquipButtons_Click 11 and 12)
notes: Steps run MME's own procedures cut from frmMain.frm. A Find Best is the pair cmdEquipButtons_Click(11) (clears bInvenNextBest, PopupMenu blanked) and one mnuFindBest*_Click(Index); a Next Best is cmdEquipButtons_Click(12), which replays nInvenLastIndex.

Each Find Best / Next Best step captures eq = nEquippedItem, last = nInvenLastIndex (index, menu) and excl = nInvenExcludedItems (a leading 0 is the ReDim placeholder; an unallocated array reads as the error it raises).

Lists: LoadInvenItems / FilterInvenItems (a level-50 character) or InvenSetupEquip plus InvenAddEquip. The final read has every combo's ItemData in list order; the oracle's combos are not Sorted, so ties go to the first entry in table or insertion order.

InvenFindBestItemValue reads the cached DAO Field objects (`Set fldAbil(z) = tabItems.Fields(..)`), which follow the recordset's cursor in DAO; the shim's Fields() returns a value, so those two reads go to the recordset directly.
Rows numbered 9001 and up are invented (db_extra); data holds every armour and weapon row as [number, type, weapon type, encum, AC, DR, accuracy, limit, [[ability, value]..], worn].
